name: checkoverdue-duedate-precedence-over-estduedate
branch: checkOverdue()'s batch filter enforces duedate-over-est_duedate precedence and the status__state='open' + isoverdue=0 gate: a past duedate flags a ticket regardless of est_duedate, a null-duedate ticket falls back to a past est_duedate, a future duedate excludes the ticket even with a past est_duedate, and a closed ticket with a past duedate is excluded entirely
